thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild for runtime nodes next Tue (window 02:00-05:00 UTC). Primary goals: pick up latest distro CVEs, rotate the KMS signing key, and land RBAC least-priv changes that unblock the new cosign flow. Any major conflicts?
ashok: +1 from runtime side. One ask: will the KMS rotation change the service-account roles used by the runner?
olivia: Yes — after key rotation the image-signer SA needs crypto.signBlob + kms.encrypt. I'm drafting the minimal IAM bindings now. cc @ashok for deployment perms.
ryan: For audit logs — we need to start shipping detailed cosign verification events to our audit pipeline. Right now we only log push events, not verify ops. That will make post-incident forensics easier.
cj: Agree. We can add a lightweight shim that emits a structured line to stdout during verify: e.g. 
```
{
  "event": "image.verify",
  "image": "gcr.io/redwood/runtime:sha256-abc123",
  "verifier": "cosign",
  "signer_keyid": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/cosign-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3",
  "result": "ok",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-21T02:05:12Z"
}
```
maria: That looks good. let's ensure the shim is idempotent and non-blocking for startup. We should also gate verify logs behind a feature flag in case we need to roll back.
sec-bot: Reminder: security freeze period applies 24h before the rebuild window. Please file any hotfix exceptions.
ashok: Noted. Questions about rollout: do we canary the base image on a subset of runtime nodes? What's the target canary size?
olivia: Recommend 3% of capacity (roughly 10 nodes) in us-west to validate cosign and KMS interactions. If metrics look good after 30m we expand to 25% then full.
ryan: Add queries we'll monitor: image.verify.failure_rate, image.launch.latency, cosign.kms.rpc_errors. Dashboards will show per-region breakdown.
cj: Also add image provenance histogram (signed_by_count) so we can catch images inadvertently double-signed or unsigned.
maria: Deployment playbook checklist draft:
- Prewindow: rotate build keystore (cosign key) and produce a signed test artifact.
- Prewindow: apply RBAC binding changes in a canary namespace.
- Window start: deploy canary nodes with new base image + verification shim enabled.
- 00:30: run smoke: pull test artifact, verify, run basic app smoke, check metrics.
- 01:00: roll to 25% if green.
- 02:00: full roll if previous step green.
- Postwindow: rotate runtime SA tokens, export audit logs to long-term storage.
ashok: Two risk items: (1) potential flakiness from the shim causing startup timeouts; (2) KMS quota for encrypt/sign ops if we verify a lot during canary. We should pre-warm KMS and throttle verification.
olivia: For KMS quotas I've asked infra to request a short-term increase for the window. We'll also implement token-bucket in the shim to limit verify qps.
ryan: Incident response note: if cosign verification starts failing en masse, fallback policy should pull the last known-good image by tag and mark the problematic digest in the registry for forensics. We should automate that in the rollout controller.
maria: Good. Who's owning the rollout controller change?
ashok: I'll own the controller patch, cj will own the shim and logging change. Olivia will own IAM docs and the RBAC rollout. Ryan will add the dashboards and alerting. I'll open PRs by EOD Friday.
cj: I'll also add a feature-flag gate and a kill-switch env var so ops can disable verify logging instantly.
sec-bot: Note: attach the CVE sync report to the rollout ticket and include the list of upgraded packages.
maria: Thanks everyone. Action items: PRs + test artifact by Fri EOD; prewarm KMS request; canary nodes ready in us-west; dashboards + alerts created. Meet again Mon 16:00 UTC for final go/no-go.
ryan: ack.
olivia: ack.
ashok: ack.
cj: ack.
sec-bot: Automated note: security freeze will be enforced at 2025-10-20T02:00:00Z.
